title: Viva Insights: Copilot Analytics Agent Dashboard for agent adoption and Copilot Credit usage
summary: The briefing correctly reports the roadmap and notice date disagreement, the preview default, and the documented access controls. However, its description of Copilot Credit metrics omits the required Copilot Chat filter and pay-as-you-go conditions, and does not say those metrics are absent from the Agent 365 view. Minor corrections should also distinguish access assignment from VFAM and keep the governance checklist aligned with its controls table.
